thread:
marco: Heads-up: quick sync — I pushed an RFC for the kernel microbatch change and a KV warmup follow-up. Where are we on review/QA? We need to hit the mid-sprint milestone tomorrow. TL;DR: microbatch PR #412, kv-warmup branch 'kv-warmup/auto-warm'.

sophie: On it — left comments on #412 this morning. Main blocker is the override for sequence_len edge-case. Also saw a perf regression on long-seq smoke: ~12% tail latency increase in the canary. I'm running a bisect now. @ryan can you pick up the seq_len fix?

ryan: Yep, I'll take it. Looking at the test failure now — suspicion: kernel_shard placement mismatch during prefetch. I'll send a small patch by EOD. Also need someone to re-run the canary with kv prewarm enabled. @deploy-bot can you trigger a canary with tag kv-prewarm-1?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary request queued: kv-prewarm-1 on cluster-2. Canary started 12:14UTC. Link: https://deploys.internal/canary/1756002468-kv-prewarm-1 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anya: FYI infra team flagged a memory plateau with the prewarm config in prod-sim. We should cap prewarm concurrency to 8 while we stabilize. Added note to the RFC. Also can we get an owners list for rollout? Marco, Sophie, Ryan — does that work?

sophie: owners: kernel-microbatch = @sophie, kernel-placement = @ryan, kv-warmup = @marco, infra caps = @infrastructure (cc @anya). I'll open a follow-up PR with the cap change. Quick config snippet I'm proposing:

```
kv_warmup:
  concurrency: 8
  init_backoff_ms: 200
```

marco: Ack. I'll update the RFC with a short rollout checklist and an eval prompt set (small subset) to watch for generation regressions. If Ryan posts the seq_len patch, I'll queue a hotfix roll-forward. Thanks :thumbsup:

ryan: posted patch: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/419 — includes unit + integration tests. Running local perf; no regressions so far. ETA to merge ~2 hours if canary looks good.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary finished. Result: partial success. kv-prewarm-1: CPU spike observed on 3/10 instances, median latency improved by 6%, tail (p95) unchanged. Full logs: https://deploys.internal/logs/1756002468-kv-prewarm-1

sophie: Ok that's actionable. I'll triage the CPU spike — likely prewarm worker spin-up. If it's just 3 instances, we can retry with lower init concurrency. @marco can you schedule a quick re-canary for 30m window?

marco: Scheduling now for 30m. Thanks everyone.
